title: Local providers and configuration file
description: Configure each connection once for multiple models. Cloud-delivered models remain independently managed.
keyUnchanged: Configured; leave blank to keep unchanged
keyHint: Keys entered here are encrypted on this device; YAML contains a credential reference. Do not share or commit files containing an inline api_key.
inheritedConnection: URL and key are inherited from this provider; advanced capabilities are model-specific.
batchHint: Batch add: one model ID per line, or comma separated
discoveryFailed: Discovery failed; manual model IDs remain available.
noNewModels: Enter or select at least one model ID not already configured.
migrationDescription: Group {{count}} standalone local models by matching URL, key and protocol. Preserve IDs, capabilities and conversation references. Cloud models are excluded. Duplicate legacy storage entries are removed after migration.
fileHint: UI saves update this file. Reload after external edits; invalid files retain the last valid configuration.
empty: Add a provider or bind an existing model.yml.
deleteProviderDescription: Remove “{{name}}” and its {{count}} models from local configuration. Existing conversations will not silently switch connections.
deleteModelDescription: Remove “{{name}}” from the local file. Existing conversations retain the original reference instead of switching services.
catalogHint: New catalog entries synchronize when the executor is idle; running tasks are not forcibly restarted.
